explanation: Manriquez holds the Apprendi challenge foreclosed by Slaughter under the one-panel rule, so it treats it as binding; but Slaughter is a reasoned per curiam printed at 238 F.3d 580 (merely attaching an earlier unpublished opinion), so it is published. Limb 1 fails.

Brooks is a full reasoned opinion printed at 299 Ill. App. 3d 68, so published. Norris cites it 'see also' and sees 'no reason to depart' from Baaske and Brooks: adherence to prior decisions, not a statement of being bound. Limbs 1 and 2 fail.

Woodruff is a full Court of Appeals opinion printed at 93 N.Y. 609, so published. Frank, a separate action over the same lease, cites and quotes it as this court's own authority without saying it is bound. Limb 1 fails.

Colon is a published Illinois Supreme Court opinion, 225 Ill. 2d 125; only the appellate order it reviewed was a Rule 23 order. Boeckmann cites it merely for the general stare decisis standard, not as controlling the result. Limbs 1 and 2 fail.

Resendez-Villavueva accepts the concession that the argument is foreclosed by Morales-Mota and summarily affirms, treating it as binding; but Morales-Mota is a reasoned per curiam published at 704 F.3d 410, so precedential. Limb 1 fails.

Chavez holds the Apprendi challenge to section 841(b) foreclosed by 'our opinion in' Slaughter, treating it as binding; but Slaughter is a published opinion at 238 F.3d 580, only its attached original opinion was unpublished. Limb 1 fails.

Schultz calls Thompson 'dispositive of the issue' and applies it over the cases defendant urged; but Thompson is a full opinion printed at 166 Ill. App. 3d 909, published; only its own earlier appeals were Rule 23 orders. Limb 1 fails.
